description_en: Queries the basic information of cloud computers
description_zh: 查询云电脑的基础信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-desktop-info --business-channel Enterprise --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --need-extra-info true --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDesktopInfo

parameters.help_en:
The business channel. Valid values:
Enterprise: Enterprise Edition.
Business: Business Edition
parameters.help_zh:
业务渠道, 取值：
Enterprise：企业版
Business：商业版
parameters.name: business_channel

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The cloud computer ID. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the extended information of the cloud computer
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回云电脑的扩展信息
parameters.name: need_extra_info
